teach_steps.example:
WORKED MODEL
Follow the vowel plan: tally A E I O U on one page → column graph → conclusion: “E appeared most with 42 tallies; U least with 9.” Mention sample (one page) so you do not overclaim.

TRY FIRST
Using your plan, list the first three actions you will take today and the graph you will draw.

FEEDBACK
Actions match the plan order; graph type matches the data type chosen in planning.
teach_steps.explain:
Carry out the investigation by following the plan, recording every trial or response, then present results with a graph and a conclusion that quotes the data.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
teach_steps.notice: Changing the question halfway through makes the presentation answer a different investigation. Correct the value or method, not just the appearance of the digits.
